narr: Above normal moisture laying across Central New York combined with an area of low pressure moving over Lake Ontario to produce numerous rounds of heavy rain producing thunderstorms during the afternoon. Weak frontal boundaries associated with the low pressure focused storms primarily over the Finger Lakes region where flash flooding was severe.
ev: Street flooding was reported in Truxton. There were several areas of mud and debris deposited on roads, bridges and blocking culverts.
Flooding occurring over State road NY-34 to the north of the Scipio Fire Department.
Flooding occurring in the Town of Owasco near NY-38A and Rockefeller Road.
There was widespread small stream and creek flooding, along with street flooding, reported in Niles.
Spotters reported road flooding near Split Rock Road and NY-38a.
Multiple roadways were reported to have water rushing over them from Skaneateles and points east along U.S. Route 20.
Serious urban flooding was reported from East Syracuse across the southern sections of the City of Syracuse and portions of Onondaga county.
Multiple roads are flooded in Preble.
A neighborhood of manufactured homes was flooded in this area.
Officials reported street flooding and trees down and across roads in the area.
